correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=3, direct gap-classification proves 2^(m-1)+5 ideals; the quantified dual equals the explicit adjacent-two-zero witness rule. Every excluded low gap remains excluded in the bidual exactly when it has an excluded neighbor; the symmetric one-gap family is handled by the Frobenius complement involution. Stars-and-bars and a regular-language generating function give the recurrence and asymptotic. The standalone finite checker was executed for m=3..13 in both families; these finite tests are auxiliary, not proof of universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: It quantifies an intrinsic semigroup ideal invariant in two natural neighboring conductor-2m families and exposes a qualitative change: all normalized ideals are reflexive with one terminal hole but an exponentially vanishing fraction are reflexive after the second hole. The local bidual fill rule and exact generating function are reusable structural information rather than a small lookup table.
